state.question: When does the town library open on weekdays, and did visits change after the renovation?
state.source: The town library opens at nine on weekdays. According to the library's annual report, visits doubled after the reading room was renovated.
state.answer: It opens at eight on weekdays and closes at six. Visits tripled after the 2023 renovation, which cost 1.2 million dollars according to the council's budget review.
